page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question
Excretory Products and their Elimination · 2 marks

steps.label: Definition
steps.why: The rate is counted for both kidneys together because that is what a clinical test measures.
common_mistakes: Defining it for one kidney. It is for both kidneys.
Saying it is the amount of urine. It is the amount of filtrate.
steps.memory_tip: Filtrate from both kidneys in one minute.
lines: Glomerular filtration rate is the amount of
filtrate formed by both the kidneys in one

steps.label: The value
steps.why: About 180 litres are filtered a day, which is why almost all of it has to be taken back further along the tubule.
common_mistakes: Giving the figure per day when the definition says per minute.
steps.memory_tip: 125 mL a minute, about 180 litres a day.

lines.text: GFR is about 125 mL per minute

insider_note: Half the marks are in the number. Write 125 mL per minute.
